name: Nephilim
overview: The Nephilim are described in Scripture as giants or mighty men who lived on the earth in ancient times, particularly noted in Genesis when the 'sons of God' took wives from the daughters of men, resulting in offspring who were men of renown. These beings are also referenced later in the Old Testament as formidable giants, such as the sons of Anak, who caused fear among the Israelites during their journey to possess the Promised Land. The biblical narrative highlights their great size and strength, underscoring the challenges faced by God's people and pointing to His sovereign plan in history.
